explanation: There are 3 TECHNICAL_HOLD objects defined in technical-verification-holds.json. However, only HOLD-002 binds a specific source rule from SA1 (RULE-AND-R8-000317), giving exactly 1 primary TECHNICAL_VERIFICATION_HOLD rule in rule-dispositions.jsonl. The other two holds (HOLD-001 for Android XR Display Glasses and HOLD-003 for Media3 Cast Wi-Fi drops) represent architectural-level capability claims held pending hardware verification without directly binding primary rules from the SA1 corpus. Hence, technical-hold objects (3) and primary held rules (1) do not and should not match.
